name: Tara gum
aliases: E417, tara gum, tara seed gum, tara galactomannan, Peruvian carob, Caesalpinia spinosa gum, goma tara, gomme tara
what_is: A galactomannan gum obtained from the endosperm of tara seeds and used mainly as a thickener and stabiliser.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because it is a texture-modifying additive that may be declared as E417 or by name, while permitted uses and levels are set by jurisdiction.
can_1: Identify E417 or tara gum when declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the E-number and texture information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the concentration used from a standard ingredient list.
cannot_2: Determine the raw-material origin, extraction conditions or purity profile from the label alone.
